Indrajeet and others), arising out of Case Crime No.224 of 2024, under sections 419, 420, 506 IPC, P.S. 3.

entities.text: Civil Judge (Senior Division), Court No.2, Gorakhpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for applicants submitted that there is hardly any case of impostering the persons,
who are entered into execution of registered sale deed and the role of applicants has been apparent from the narration of FIR being marginal witnesses only.

It is also submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that the extension of limitation for identification in respect of persons who are entered into a settlement which has been registered as sale deed and the same has been witnessed by the applicants, since there is hardly any case of dubious identity and as such the implication of applicants in Case Crime No.224 of 2024 are highly illegal.4.

Per contra, learned AGA however oppose the prayer as made through the instant application, but did not dispute that the facts of the matter does not disclosing any identification of the persons or the personalities, who entered into deed performed by the seller and purchaser and as such the role of marginal witnesses are very limited only for identification or authentification of the persons concerned.
5.
Since the legal question has already been raised in this matter, which is apparent from the records and as such process to issue notice to opposite party no.2 is hereby dispensed with.

6. In view of aforementioned facts and circumstances of the case, implication of applicants being the marginal witnesses in Case Crime No.224 of 2024 are not sustainable and it is apparent from the records that they have dragged into unwarranted criminal litigation for which they are not liable to be shouldered with any type of offence as mentioned in the cognizance order passed by learned court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gorakhpur.

7. In view of above, the entire proceedings of Case No.49333 of 2024 (State Vs. Indrajeet and others), arising out of Case Crime No.224 of 2024, under sections 419, 420, 506 IPC, P.S. Chiluatal,
District- Gorakhpur, pending in the court of learned Civil Judge (Senior Division), Court No.2,
Gorakhpur, including charge-sheet dated 08.08.2024 along with cognizance/summoning order dated 16.10.2024, are hereby set-aside in respect of applicants only.
